statements.text: Produced by the Planetary Science Institute from Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter SHARAD observations and archived by the NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node.
statements.evidence: PDS4 label mro:producer_institution_name is PLANETARY SCIENCE INSTITUTE; readme.txt names the bundle citation.

statements.text: NASA scientific data; the bundle asks that its published citation be used.
statements.evidence: readme.txt, Citation line naming Putzig et al. (2025) and doi:10.17189/a5av-yc11.

statements.text: The volumes are published three-dimensional reconstructions on a delay-time vertical axis referenced to the areoid plus 10.125 km, not measured depths, and the bundle supplies no dielectric conversion.
statements.evidence: Array_3D description in each data label; 3d_processing_v2.0.pdf user guide.

statements.text: Release notes record imaging artifacts along three mispositioned input tracks in the Planum Australe version 1 volume.
